records.jp: ふぅ……
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en_auxiliary: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: お疲れ、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Nice work, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Nice work, Hina.
records.en: Nice work, Hina.

records.jp: いい感じだったね
records.en_original: You're a natural at this.
records.en_auxiliary: You're a natural at this.
records.en: You're a natural at this.

records.jp: それで、教えてくれるんでしょ？<CR>この力のこと……
records.en_original: So, now you're going to tell me all about...whatever this is, right?
records.en_auxiliary: So, now you're going to tell me all about whatever this is, right?
records.en: So, now you're going to tell me all about...whatever this is, right?

records.jp: うん。リフレクターはね、フラグメントの力で戦う<CR>魔法少女なの！
records.en_original: Sure! We Reflectors are magical girls who fight with the power of Fragments!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure! We Reflectors are magical girls who fight with the power of Fragments!
records.en: Sure! We Reflectors are magical girls who fight with the power of Fragments!

records.jp: フラグメント？
records.en_original: Fragments?
records.en_auxiliary: Fragments?
records.en: Fragments?

records.jp: 正しくはエーテルフラグメント。人の強い感情によってできる<CR>“想いの欠片”のこと
records.en_original: Technically, Ether Fragments. In a nutshell, they're "emotion shards," created by strong feelings.
records.en_auxiliary: Technically, Ether Fragments. In a nutshell, they're "emotion shards" created by strong feelings.
records.en: Technically, Ether Fragments. In a nutshell, they're "emotion shards," created by strong feelings.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんも今朝、早苗ちゃんのに触れたでしょう？
records.en_original: You came into contact with Sanae's this morning.
records.en_auxiliary: You came into contact with Sanae's this morning.
records.en: You came into contact with Sanae's this morning.

records.jp: あれがフラグメントだよ。魔物からフラグメントを守るのが<CR>リフレクターの仕事なの
records.en_original: That was a Fragment. A Reflector's job is to protect keep them safe from demons.
records.en_auxiliary: That was a Fragment. A Reflector's job is to keep them safe from monsters.
records.en: That was a Fragment. A Reflector's job is to protect keep them safe from demons.

records.jp: でも、中にはフラグメントを固定化して、<CR>みんなと力を共有できる人もいる
records.en_original: And some Reflectors can stabilize Fragments and share their strength with everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: And some Reflectors can stabilize Fragments and share their strength with others.
records.en: And some Reflectors can stabilize Fragments and share their strength with everyone.

records.jp: 固定化？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: ヒナちゃんがまさにそうだよ。<CR>もう苗ちんのフラグメントを持ってるしね
records.en_original: You're one of those Reflectors, Hina. You already have Nae's Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: You're one of those Reflectors, Hina. You already have Nae's Fragment.
records.en: You're one of those Reflectors, Hina. You already have Nae's Fragment.

records.jp: 苗ちんって早苗のこと……？<CR>それに、フラグメントを私が持ってる？
records.en_original: Nae? You mean, Sanae? And what do you mean I have her Fragment? And what do you mean by "stabilize"?
records.en_auxiliary: Nae? You mean, Sanae? And what do you mean I have her Fragment?
records.en: Nae? You mean, Sanae? And what do you mean I have her Fragment? And what do you mean by "stabilize"?

records.jp: その指輪から伝わるはずだよ。<CR>今朝、固定化した、苗ちんの気持ちが
records.en_original: You should be able to feel Nae's feelings in that ring-- you did stabilize them this morning, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: You should be able to feel Nae's feelings in that ring. You did stabilize them this morning, after all.
records.en: You should be able to feel Nae's feelings in that ring-- you did stabilize them this morning, after all.

records.jp: ……！<CR>なんか、感覚的にだけど、確かに存在するのはわかる……
records.en_original: ...! I don't know how I can sense them, but you're right. They're really there...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know how I can sense them, but you're right. They're really there...
records.en: ...! I don't know how I can sense them, but you're right. They're really there...

records.jp: けど、どうやって固定化したんだろう
records.en_original: But how did I stabilize them?
records.en_auxiliary: But how did I stabilize them?
records.en: But how did I stabilize them?

records.jp: フラグメントに触れた時、苗ちんの感情が流れ込んできたでしょ？<CR>ヒナちゃんがその感情を理解できたからだよ
records.en_original: When you touched the Fragment, Nae's feelings flowed into you, didn't they? You felt the way she felt.
records.en_auxiliary: When you touched the Fragment, Nae's feelings flowed into you, didn't they? You felt the way she felt.
records.en: When you touched the Fragment, Nae's feelings flowed into you, didn't they? You felt the way she felt.

records.jp: どういう意味かは、わかるでしょ……？
records.en_original: You remember, don't you?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you get what I'm saying?
records.en: You remember, don't you?

records.en_original: Oh...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh...
records.en: Oh...

records.jp: そうやってフラグメントを集めて、力を蓄えるの。<CR>原種という強大な敵を倒すために……
records.en_original: That's how you collect Fragments and gain power. You'll need it to defeat the mighty enemies known as the Sephirot...
records.en_auxiliary: That's how you collect Fragments and gain power. You'll need it to defeat the mighty enemies known as the Sephira...
records.en: That's how you collect Fragments and gain power. You'll need it to defeat the mighty enemies known as the Sephirot...

records.jp: 強大な敵？　今戦ったあいつらじゃないの？
records.en_original: Are you talking about the things we just fought? They didn't seem all that mighty to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you talking about the things we just fought? They didn't seem all that mighty to me.
records.en: Are you talking about the things we just fought? They didn't seem all that mighty to me.

records.jp: あの魔物たちは、原種たちの力の影響でコモンがおかしくなって<CR>生まれてきた下っ端。原種は、あんなものじゃない
records.en_original: Those demons are just the byproducts of the Sephira's impact on the Common. Sephirot are on another level.
records.en_auxiliary: Those monsters are just the byproducts of the Sephira's impact on the Common. Sephira are on another level.
records.en: Those demons are just the byproducts of the Sephira's impact on the Common. Sephirot are on another level.

records.jp: まずはリンリンのフラグメントを探しに行こう！
records.en_original: Enough talk! We've got to find Rin-Rin's Fragment!
records.en_auxiliary: Enough talk! We've gotta find Rin-Rin's Fragment!
records.en: Enough talk! We've got to find Rin-Rin's Fragment!

records.jp: なんで、私が……
records.en_original: Do I have to?
records.en_auxiliary: Do I have to?
records.en: Do I have to?

records.jp: あのまま放っておいたら、<CR>凛ちゃんのフラグメントは壊されちゃうよ？
records.en_original: If we don't do something, Rin's Fragment will be shattered.
records.en_auxiliary: If we don't do something, Rin's Fragment will be shattered.
records.en: If we don't do something, Rin's Fragment will be shattered.

records.jp: 壊れたら、どうなるの……？
records.en_original: And what does that mean?
records.en_auxiliary: And what does that mean?
records.en: And what does that mean?

records.jp: 精神が傷つく。フラグメントはあくまで想いの欠片だから<CR>ひとつ壊されたくらい問題ない
records.en_original: Her spirit will be damaged. Still, a Fragment is only a part of a person's feelings, so losing one isn't a problem.
records.en_auxiliary: Her spirit will be damaged. Though, a Fragment is only a part of a person's<CR>feelings, so losing one isn't a problem.
records.en: Her spirit will be damaged. Still, a Fragment is only a part of a person's feelings, so losing one isn't a problem.

records.jp: だけど、何個も壊されると最終的には……<CR>精神が破壊され、死に至る可能性もある
records.en_original: But when several Fragments are shattered... A person's spirit can be destroyed, which may lead to her death.
records.en_auxiliary: But when several Fragments are shattered...a person's spirit can be destroyed, which may lead to her death.
records.en: But when several Fragments are shattered... A person's spirit can be destroyed, which may lead to her death.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: What...!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What...!?

records.jp: それでも行かない？
records.en_original: Even knowing that, will you still turn back?
records.en_auxiliary: Knowing that, will you still turn back?
records.en: Even knowing that, will you still turn back?

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina...

records.jp: もし……もし、コモンで魔物にやられたら、どうなるの？
records.en_original: If... If you're defeated by a demon in the Common, what happens to you?
records.en_auxiliary: If... If you're defeated by a monster in the Common, what happens to you?
records.en: If... If you're defeated by a demon in the Common, what happens to you?

records.jp: 現実世界に戻されるだけ。特にリスクはない
records.en_original: Nothing. You're just returned to the real world. There's no risk at all.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing. You're just returned to the real world. There's no risk at all.
records.en: Nothing. You're just returned to the real world. There's no risk at all.

records.jp: ……はぁ。わかった。行く
records.en_original: ...Sigh. Fine. I'll go with you.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* Fine. I'll go with you.
records.en: ...Sigh. Fine. I'll go with you.

records.jp: 凛ちゃんのフラグメントはこの近くにあるはず。急ぎましょう
records.en_original: Rin's Fragment should be nearby. Let's hurry.
records.en_auxiliary: Rin's Fragment should be nearby. Let's hurry.
records.en: Rin's Fragment should be nearby. Let's hurry.

records.jp: ～エーテルチャージについて～
records.en_original: ~About Ether Charge~
records.en_auxiliary: ~About Ether Charge~
records.en: ~About Ether Charge~

records.jp: エーテルチャージが使用可能になりました
records.en_original: You can now make use of Ether Charge.
records.en_auxiliary: You can now make use of Ether Charge.
records.en: You can now make use of Ether Charge.

records.jp: ＭＰはコマンド「エーテルチャージ」を使用すると<CR>回復することができます
records.en_original: Choose the command "Ether Charge" to recover your MP.
records.en_auxiliary: Choose the command "Ether Charge" to recover your MP.
records.en: Choose the command "Ether Charge" to recover your MP.

records.jp: ＭＰが不足した際に「エーテルチャージ」を使用しましょう
records.en_original: Whenever your MP has you in a bind, Ether Charge is there!
records.en_auxiliary: Whenever your MP has you in a bind, Ether Charge is there!
records.en: Whenever your MP has you in a bind, Ether Charge is there!
